Exercise 11. a) In front of the metro station, Tuesday 14 March to 18:30. b) A small car hit a cyclist at the traffic light as he crossed the road. c) The driver, who didn't stop at the red light. d) After ten minutes. e) Light wounds to the hand; He didn't go to the hospital. f) He didn't run away and gave the ID and the car's documents. g) Who didn't see the light because of the sun. h) No witnesses, but the station camera recorded the incident (the video has not yet been seen). i) The bike is broken, the car has slight damage. j) ⁧لَمْ يَتَوَقَّفْ⁩ ( ⁧يَتَوَقَّفُ⁩ ) · ⁧لَمْ تَكُنْ⁩ ( ⁧تَكُونُ⁩ ) · ⁧لَمْ يَذْهَبْ⁩ ( ⁧يَذْهَبُ⁩ ) · ⁧لَمْ يَهْرُبْ⁩

Exercise 12. a) In the center of Amman this morning; No one's hurt. b) Egyptian Foreign Minister did not attend yesterday's meeting; The spokesman for the ministry did not say why. c) A German tourist, for stealing his bag in the old city market; The police haven't found the thief yet. d) For the delay of the plane. e) ⁧لَمْ يَذْكُرِ المُتَحَدِّثُ⁩ ( 2), ⁧لَمْ تَجِدِ الشُّرْطَةُ⁩ ( 3), ⁧لَمْ يَصِلِ الوَفْدُ⁩ ( 4): sukūn of the lawyer before the article (alif waṣla) takes one i to avoid two consonants without vowel.
Exercise 13 · Model (week 2).
⁧الأَرْبِعَاءُ ٢ مَايُو، السَّاعَةُ ١٥:١١⁩ · ⁧تَقْرِيرٌ عَنْ حَقِيبَةٍ مَفْقُودَةٍ⁩
⁧جَاءَتْ إِلَى المَرْكَزِ سَائِحَةٌ تُونِسِيَّةٌ، وَقَالَتْ إِنَّهَا فَقَدَتْ حَقِيبَتَهَا فِي الحَافِلَةِ رَقْمِ ٩٠. فِي الحَقِيبَةِ جَوَازُ سَفَرِهَا⁩
⁧وَهَاتِفُهَا وَمِئَتَا يُورُو. لَمْ تَرَ أَحَدًا يَأْخُذُ الحَقِيبَةَ، وَلَمْ تَتَذَكَّرِ المَحَطَّةَ بِالضَّبْطِ، بِسَبَبِ الزِّحَامِ. اِتَّصَلْنَا بِشَرِكَةِ⁩
⁧الحَافِلَاتِ، لٰكِنَّ السَّائِقَ لَمْ يَجِدْ شَيْئًا. لَمْ يَكُنْ عِنْدَ السَّائِحَةِ رَقْمُ القُنْصُلِيَّةِ، وَأَعْطَيْنَاهَا الرَّقْمَ. حَتَّى الآنَ لَمْ⁩
⁧يَتَّصِلْ بِنَا أَحَدٌ، وَلَمْ تَصِلِ الحَقِيبَةُ إِلَى مَكْتَبِ المَفْقُودَاتِ بَعْدُ.⁩
⁧لُوكَا⁩ : ⁧الشُّرْطِيُّ⁩

( 97 words.) ⁧بِالضَّبْطِ⁩ Exactly, ⁧الزِّحَام⁩ • the battering force, ⁧مَكْتَبُ المَفْقُودَاتِ⁩ Lost and Found Office are new words: in your text you can do without it. ⁧مِئَتَا يُورُو⁩ EUR 200 (A2-12). Exercise 14. a) He didn't hear the alarm clock, the car didn't leave, the bus didn't arrive (and he didn't find his phone to warn). The meeting wasn't long and the director said nothing important. The translation of the report has not yet arrived. b) 1. The weather wasn't good ( ⁧يَكُونُ⁩ ) · 2. He didn't tell the truth ( ⁧يَقُولُ⁩ ) ·
3. We didn't see anyone ( ⁧نَرَى⁩ ) · 4. They didn't come ( ⁧يَأْتُونَ⁩ ) · 5. Haven't you forgotten? (f.) ( ⁧تَنْسَيْنَ⁩ ) · 6. No

lives more here ( ⁧يَعُودُ⁩ … ⁧يَسْكُنُ⁩ ) · 7. The bus has not arrived yet ( ⁧تَصِلُ⁩ ) · 8. I didn't sleep well ( ⁧أَنَامُ⁩ ). c) 1. Algiers: Tunisian Prime Minister has arrived, but he has not yet met with the Algerian President. 2. Cairo: road accident on the airport road, no serious injuries. 3. Beirut: The airport didn't work for two hours because of the rain. 4. Shooting: police haven't found the missing child yet.
